modelingNotes: Identity: order 29450 = Schneider standard auxiliary/indication contact, signal-contact composition 1 NO/NC (a single change-over/SPDT micro-switch), circuit-breaker status OF/SD/SDE/SDV, screwless spring terminals. Confirmed on se.com product 29450 and Schneider 29450 product data sheet (2015-05-12).

Intrinsic bare-part markings are1(common C),2(NC/break),4(NO/make), as drawn in NNZ4314501-02 p.9. Normal states describe the unactuated accessory, not a universal breaker state. Section8 pp.14–15 distinguishes installed functions: OF has1–2 closed for breaker open/tripped and1–4 for closed; SD has1–2 for not-tripped open/closed and1–4 for trip; SDE transfers to1–4 on electrical trip; SDV transfers on earth-leakage trip. Static functions do not simulate these mechanisms.

The installation slot defines the function (OF/SD/SDE/SDV); the shipped accessory label renumbers the same 1/2/4 terminals per slot (section 7, p.13): OF1 11/12/14, OF2 21/22/24, OF3 31/32/34, OF4 41/42/44, SD 91/92/94, SDE 81/82/84, SDV 71/72/74 (pattern common x1, NC x2, NO x4). These are applied labels, not additional physical terminals; the type models the bare contact's intrinsic 1/2/4.

No permanent conducting jumper: common terminal 1 is joined to 2 or to 4 only through the breaker-driven mechanism (a change-over has no fixed internal link). No PE, coil, supply, shield or communication terminal exists on this part.

Ratings are conditional and cover AC and DC, so no scalar terminal rating is asserted. Product data sheet p.1: Ith 6 A conventional free-air thermal current; minimum load 100 mA at 24 V; Ie e.g. AC-12 6 A up to 690 V, AC-15 0.1 A at 660/690 V / 2 A at 380/440 V / 4 A at 220/240 V / 5 A at 110 V, DC-12 6 A at 24 V down to 0.3 A at 250 V, DC-14 1 A at 24 V down to 0.003 A at 250 V. Spring terminals accept 0.5-1.5 mm2 / 20-16 AWG.

Companion part 29452 is the screw-terminal ('low level') equivalent; the instruction sheet warns the terminal positions differ between 29450 and 29452. An RS Components reseller listing calling Merlin Gerin 29450 a 'screw terminal' contact is not corroborated by a manufacturer source and does not change the 1/2/4 change-over model.

The opened data sheet lists ComPacT NSX 100-250/400-630, CVS, INS, INV, NG160, NR, NSC100; the instruction sheet also covers ComPacT NS630b-3200. Exact fit onto the legacy Merlin-Gerin Compact NS100-630 frame is not itemised in the opened docs; order code, 1 NO/NC composition and OF/SD/SDE/SDV function set match exactly.

connectionCoverage.notes: All three electrical terminals of the single change-over contact are inventoried: common (1), NC/break (2) and NO/make (4). This is the part's entire electrical connection set - no PE, coil, supply or communication terminal exists. Function per slot (OF/SD/SDE/SDV) and the applied label numbering (11/12/14... 91/92/94... 71/72/74) are application-dependent and are documented, not added as extra terminals.

1.description: Common pole (marked 'C'); relabelled x1 by slot (11/21/31/41 OF, 91 SD, 81 SDE, 71 SDV)

2.description: NC/break throw in the bare-contact reference state; installed actuation depends on OF/SD/SDE/SDV slot. Applied label x2.

4.description: NO/make throw in the bare-contact reference state; installed actuation depends on OF/SD/SDE/SDV slot. Applied label x4.
